product_family: Things 3 — personal task management app for Mac, iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Vision Pro; includes Things Cloud sync service (free with app purchase)

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on vendor domain. No SOC 2 report, trust center, or compliance page found. Cultured Code is a 12-person consumer-focused company with no enterprise compliance documentation.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on vendor domain. No ISO 27001 certificate or any mention found on any Cultured Code page.

certifications.name: GDPR (EU compliance posture)
certifications.proof_quote: We collect and process all your personal data in accordance with the relevant data protection regulations, in particular the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the German Federal Data Protection Act (BDSG) and the German Telecommunications Digital Services Data Protection Act (TDDDG).

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on vendor domain. Product is a personal task manager with no healthcare use case; no HIPAA mention found anywhere on the site.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Not applicable. Purchases are processed through the Apple App Store; Cultured Code does not handle payment card data directly.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: Not applicable. Things 3 has no AI features. Cultured Code is not an AI company and does not operate AI/ML pipelines.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence on vendor domain. unknown / no public evidence.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: Not applicable. Consumer-focused German product with no US federal government use case or mention.

privacy.ai_training_note: Things 3 has no AI features and does not train on customer data. The privacy policy states data may be used for internal research to improve products, but there is no AI component or training program. A dedicated support article warns users not to share Things Cloud credentials with AI tools, reinforcing that the service is not integrated with AI pipelines.
privacy.data_region: EU / Germany likely. Company HQ in Stuttgart, Germany; compliance with GDPR, BDSG, and TDDDG. Specific hosting location (data center) not publicly disclosed.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS with 2048-bit certificate for all Things Cloud data exchange between client and server

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: 256-bit AES encryption; no data stored in clear text on Things Cloud servers

security.name: End-to-end encryption
security.value: Not implemented. Data is decryptable by Cultured Code on their servers. Noted by independent privacy community as a limitation.

security.name: Access control
security.value: Access to personal information restricted to employees who need it; employees bound by confidentiality agreements and subject to discipline including termination

security.name: Security reviews
security.value: Internal reviews of data collection, storage, and processing practices mentioned in privacy policy; no independent third-party audit evidence found

security.name: Data deletion
security.value: Users can request deletion of Things Cloud account and all associated content via app settings; some data may be retained for legal compliance periods

security.name: Tracking and analytics
security.value: No tracking, no analytics, no profiling on Things Cloud service per vendor statement

flags: No dedicated trust center or security page; security information is scattered across the privacy policy and individual support articles
No publicly available DPA (Data Processing Agreement); limits suitability for enterprise, regulated, or public-sector procurement
No SOC 2, ISO 27001, or any third-party security audit certification; consistent with a 12-person consumer app company but rules out regulated enterprise use
Data hosting / data center location not publicly disclosed; EU residency is likely given German HQ and GDPR compliance but cannot be confirmed from public documentation
No end-to-end encryption; task data is readable by Cultured Code on the server side — privacy-focused users should note this

Terms of Service grants Cultured Code a broad worldwide license to 'use, host, store, reproduce, modify, create derivative works, communicate, and distribute' user content; stated to be for 'limited purpose of operating and improving our Service' but the language is broader than necessary
Things Cloud Terms of Service was last modified August 16, 2012 — over a decade old — and may not reflect current GDPR obligations, AI-era considerations, or modern data practices
